name: manipulation-mfc-bench
description: Manipulation MFC Bench evaluates models on robotic manipulation tasks, focusing on contact-rich interactions and fine manipulation capabilities. It provides episodes or instances with sensor observations, action sequences, and success/failure labels to assess planning, control, and prediction performance in manipulation scenarios. The benchmark is intended to measure robustness across varied objects, contact conditions, and manipulation strategies.
reputation: A specialized research benchmark aimed at the robotics manipulation community with limited but growing use in academic robotics and control research.
